description:
Cast Clockspinning by paying {U} due to Mindsplice Apparatus.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Clockspinning.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Mindsplice Apparatus
uses.cardState: with three or more oil counters on it
